title: Electricity Bill
description: Computes a slab-based electricity bill and adds 20%.

data.question: Write a program that reads the units consumed, computes the slab bill, adds 20%, and prints the total.

brief.summary: Computes a slab-based electricity bill and adds 20%.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads the units consumed, computes the slab bill, adds 20%, and prints the total.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: Slabs charge 2 per unit to 50, 3 per unit to 150, 5 per unit to 250 and 8 per unit beyond; the total is multiplied by 1.2.
